Thus d(a)=m_S+number of eligible v∈S, and disjoint coefficient groups by head give factors (q^{r_S(v)}−1+t) or q^{r_S(v)}. Summation over λ,x proves spectrum for any prime power. Evaluating t=q counts zero-product ordered pairs. Independent height-two zero-product equations give q^m Σ_S q^{|S|+e(S)}(q−1)^{v−|S|}; star/path polynomial subtraction q^6(q−1)^3 and opposite-star difference follow. Finite rank checks supplement, not replace, this proof.
